questions.addressed_to_me: Is this addressed to {{name}} by name in any case or position, an @mention, or a reply in a thread {{name}} is in, AND does it want something from {{name}} (a question, a request, a point to answer, an ack of something {{name}} did)? Score low if it @mentions only others, for group acks not aimed at {{name}}, and for a bare emoji or laugh in a group channel.
questions.needs_response: Does this message ask a question, report a problem, or make a request that someone doing {{name}}'s job should answer or act on? Score low for bare thanks, acknowledgements, and sign-offs.

rule: relevant if addressed_to_me >= threshold, or about_my_job >= threshold and needs_response >= threshold
